title: Grievance
text: The song-keeper comes to the edge of our lights alone. Our drills are in their hunting ground; the herds have gone. "You take and take. The ones before you took too."

choices.label: Pay them for the land
choices.reply: We send alloys and food to the camp. The song-keeper takes it, and says it changes nothing about the land. Still, they take it.

choices.label: Drills before songs
choices.reply: The song-keeper walks away. That night the camp's fire is out early. Something has been decided.
